rawInput.answer: Routes are registered via RouterGroup methods (GET/POST/etc. in routergroup.go) which call group.handle -> engine.addRoute (gin.go:364), inserting the path into a per-HTTP-method radix tree (methodTree/node.addRoute in tree.go:135). (tree.go:418) to walk the radix tree, extract path params, and return the matched handlers chain that is then executed via c.Next().

rawInput.answer: At insert time, insertChild (tree.go:288) splits a route like "/user/:name" at the wildcard: it creates a child node with nType=param whose `path` field is literally ":name" (colon kept), and sets the parent's wildChild=true. At match time, getValue (tree.go:418) reaches that node after static-prefix/index matching fails, follows the wildChild pointer, scans path forward until the next '/' or end-of-string to find the segment end, and appends Param{Key: n.path[1:] (name with colon stripped), Value: path[:end]} to the params slice (URL-unescaping the value if configured) before continuing to match any remaining path segments.
